description: Proves the §6.5 default-onError-policy branch for evidenceRequest effects: when the effect's onError field is ABSENT and the simulated status is 'failed', the runtime MUST treat the terminal as 'deferred', not 'failed'. evidenceRequest's default onError is 'defer' (response-actions.ts:241-246 effectErrorPolicy). The sibling fixture effect-deferred-evidence.json forces a 'deferred' simulated status directly; this fixture proves the default branch when the simulated status is 'failed'.

expected.defaultPolicyBranch: evidenceRequest.onError defaults to defer per response-actions.ts:241-246
